```sh
yarn dc:up          # Postgres + Mailpit (emails at http://localhost:8025)
yarn dev            # http://localhost:3000, admin at /admin
```

The first visit to `/admin` creates the owner's account. **Seed** on the
dashboard fills a development database with demo content (and deletes what is
there); it is disabled in production.

## Changing the content model

After changing a collection, global, field or block:

```sh
yarn generate:types       # src/payload-types.ts
yarn generate:importmap   # after adding an admin component
```

Before deploying a schema change, create a migration against a database with
the previous schema and commit it:

```sh
yarn payload migrate:create add-events
```

The project's skills cover the common changes: `add-block`, `add-collection`
and, with the shop, `add-payment-provider`.

## Building with Claude Code

The project ships its own guidance, stripped to the features it has:

- **`CLAUDE.md`** at the root: commands, layout and rules (Payload owns the
  schema, migrations before deploy, access enforced in collections, pages
  rendered per request, `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` inlined at build time; with the shop,
  one currency and `paymentStatus` as the record of money received).
- **Task skills** in `.claude/skills/`: `add-block` (a page-builder section),
  `add-collection` (a new kind of content in the admin) and, with the shop,
  `add-payment-provider`. Ask for the task in plain words.

See [Building with Claude Code](../../../guides/claude-code/) for the whole
workflow.

## Checks and tests

```sh
yarn typecheck && yarn lint && yarn format:check && yarn build
yarn test:int       # integration tests against the Postgres in DATABASE_URL
```
